backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the True Origin Exports logo navigation bar feature to relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short human-readable summaries describing each component's purpose and content.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with a root div and module script entry point, titled 'True Origin Company LLP'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app shell with a fixed navigation bar featuring the True Origin Exports logo, scroll-aware styling, desktop/mobile nav links, and renders all page sections in order.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About Us section displaying company description, three value proposition cards, and stats (100% Natural, 5+ Products, Global Reach).
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section on a dark forest-green background with real company phone and email links plus a functional enquiry form with submission feedback.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Export section showcasing True Origin's international shipping capabilities with two cargo images and four highlight cards covering freight, packaging, global reach, and quality certification.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, product links, contact details, and a copyright notice with smooth-scroll behavior.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a farm background image, overlay gradient, headline, tagline, CTA buttons, and a scroll-down indicator.
Displays a grid of five moringa product cards (powder, leaves, dried leaves, tea, capsules) with images, descriptions, category badges, and tags.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Shows a 'coming soon' social media section with disabled platform icons (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook) and placeholder video cards.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines an earthy green/warm cream OKLCH color palette with semantic CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based brand colors (forest, moss, sage, cream, gold), custom fonts, border radii, box shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the version, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of implemented features for the True Origin Company LLP marketing website, including contact details and planned social media integration.
